rows.grounds: compound of rasanā tongue, tālu palate, mūla root in locative

items.question: How should breath be drawn at the root of tongue and palate to destroy death?
premises: breath is drawn at tongue-palate root
practice destroys old age and death
items.inference: slow breath intake at the tongue-palate root is the prescribed technique for overcoming death
items.plain_english: Having placed the breath at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it in slowly.

rows.grounds: compound of abda year and eka one in accusative
compound of jarā old age and mṛtyu death in nominative

items.question: What happens to old age and death after one year of this breath practice?
premises: old age and death are named together
items.inference: sustained practice for one year destroys old age and death
uncertainties: whether one year is literal or symbolic
items.plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.

rows.grounds: compound of mahā great and uraga serpent in instrumental plural

items.question: Does poison enter the body of one bitten by great serpents?
premises: poison does not enter the body
even one bitten by great serpents
the claim concerns bodily entry of poison
items.inference: poison does not enter the body even when one is bitten by great serpents
uncertainties: whether this is literal immunity or yogic protection
items.plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
